title: Super beast conjugate method
author: Joe C.
desc:
SUPER BEAST CONJUGATE METHOD (SBCM) 

Lift heavy, Move fast, Grow monstrous

SBCM is an 18 week conjugate power building system designed to develop maximum strength, explosive power, and size. It combines Max Effort (ME), Dynamic Effort (DE), and progressive hypertrophy training. 

Training schedule
Four workouts performed on a rolling 8 day rotation
ME Upper
Rest
ME Lower
Rest
DE Upper
Rest
DE Lower
Rest

Take additional rest when needed for recovery. Program weeks are blocks, not calendar weeks. 

Max Effort 
Work up through progressively heavier warm-up sets to one top set of 1-3 reps around RPE 9. No failed reps or poor form. Main lift variations rotate weekly to develop strength across different movements and weak points. 

Dynamic Effort
Perform explosive bench press, squat, and deadlifts using programmed 3-step percentage waves. Percentages are based on training maxes, not comp maxes. Every rep must be fast and controlled. Reduce the weight if the bar speed falls. 

Accessories and Progression
Accessories generally use 2 hard sets, with 1-2 reps in reserve. Each set progresses independently; when a set reaches the top of its rep range, increase that sets weight for the next exposure. Other sets remain unchanged until they independently qualify. Alternative exercises have been added to most accessories; you are encouraged to rotate them every 6 weeks if you want to. If you are making crazy gains and love an exercise, keep it! You do not have to change every 6 weeks. 

Recovery and Deloads
Weeks 6, 12, and 18 are recovery weeks. Reduce intensity and volume as you see fit. Either slash the weight by 30-50%, drop sets, or both; it's all good as long as you are focusing on recovery these weeks.
